name: Effective VC Radius of Universal Class
details: For $n=1$, the one-concept class has empty effective range and value zero.
proof: For $n\geq2$, the effective coordinates of $\mathcal U_n$ are exactly the nonempty proper subsets $A\subset[n]$: its column is the membership vector of $A$ across $u_1,\ldots,u_n$, so it is nonconstant precisely in that case. Every such singleton coordinate is shattered. But any effective $A$ and its complement have only the two joint patterns $01$ and $10$ across the concepts, so that pair is not shattered. Thus the effective VC radius is one.
